test_set: 30 locked test patients; final 70-patient models; no training or tuning
prediction: TTA and post-processing exactly as in scripts 14/17 (imported)
ablation_conditions: dist_zero (distance model; unusual-input stress test, NOT a 'no distance information' condition)
ablation_zero_value: 0 = mean brain intensity of z-scored MRI (and background)

dist_counterfactual.name: anatomically controlled counterfactual distance-map perturbation (not a clinically validated anatomical replacement)
dist_counterfactual.space_check: patients are in individual native FLAIR spaces (script 10: per-patient reference grid, intra-patient registration only); equal array shapes are not treated as aligned
dist_counterfactual.donor_ranking: z-scored ventricle features ['vent_volume_ml', 'vent_centroid_rel_brain_x_mm', 'vent_centroid_rel_brain_y_mm', 'vent_centroid_rel_brain_z_mm', 'vent_spread_x_mm', 'vent_spread_y_mm', 'vent_spread_z_mm']; up to 5 nearest candidates tried in order
dist_counterfactual.registration: donor brain -> target brain, axis-aligned affine in world mm (centroid translation + per-axis scaling by brain spread); ventricle mask resampled with nearest neighbour; voxels outside the target brain removed
dist_counterfactual.distance: recomputed as in 15a: 3D EDT in mm on the target grid, clip at D_max, / D_max
dist_counterfactual.affected_voxels: target-brain voxels outside both ventricle masks whose 10 mm PV/deep assignment differs between original and counterfactual distance

metrics.cf_follows_geometry_change: AGREEMENT of the counterfactual prediction with the new geometry (affected voxels predicted abnormal in both runs); includes labels that were already consistent with it
metrics.cf_switch_fraction: fraction of those voxels whose label changed between runs
metrics.cf_switch_consistent: fraction whose label switched from the true-geometry label to the counterfactual-geometry label (primary counterfactual metric)

dist_counterfactual.skipping: no suitable donor -> target skipped and reported in counterfactual_skipped.csv
dist_counterfactual.limitation: low-DOF registration; no deformable registration (e.g. ANTs SyN) is used

distance_band_label_accuracy: PV/deep label accuracy among correctly detected abnormal voxels per band; paired distance - baseline difference, Wilcoxon + Holm across bands

integrated_gradients.baseline: all zeros (DIST = 0 = at the ventricle; DIST shares are therefore not comparable between PV and deep classes)
integrated_gradients.score: sum of softmax prob of the target class over the model's own predicted region
integrated_gradients.region: single forward pass, no TTA, no post-processing
integrated_gradients.slice: per patient, the slice with most GT abnormal WMH

uncertainty.entropy: normalised entropy of the TTA-mean softmax (total predictive uncertainty)
uncertainty.disagreement: fraction of TTA flips whose argmax differs from the final label
uncertainty.error_definition: abnormal-WMH detection errors (FP/FN); PV<->deep confusions count as correct
uncertainty.error_detection: AUROC for FP/FN vs correct voxels, (a) whole brain, (b) lesion ROI = (GT | predicted abnormal) dilated in-plane by 3 voxels

rule_based.definition: each model's saved prediction with abnormal voxels relabelled PV/deep by the 10 mm rule on the expert-mask distance map
comparisons: distance model minus baseline + 10 mm rule
distance model + 10 mm rule minus distance model
rule_based.statistics: paired Wilcoxon over patients, Holm across all comparisons, bootstrap CI

ground_truth_dependencies: distance channel computed from the EXPERT ventricle mask, also for test patients (script 17)
the 10 mm rule in the rule-based comparison uses the same expert-mask distance map
GT labels used only for fixed slice / example selection and for evaluation, never as input
reproducibility_check: intact predictions must match saved test predictions (max voxel mismatch 0.0001)
references: Griffanti et al., NeuroImage 2018 (10 mm periventricular rule)
